prompt: Why does the trainer want to delay showing the message?
promptZh: 講師為什麼想晚一點才顯示訊息？
evidence: “Then I’ll replay just the incoming updates. The controls will still respond to whatever the learners choose. Should I put a message at the top saying the device disconnected?” / “Not until we go over the exercise. Last time two groups blamed the display at first. After I showed that message, both said the device had disconnected. I’d like to hear their first explanations this time too.”

options.text: She wants to find out whether the message is correct before showing it.
options.zh: 她要先確認訊息是否正確，再給大家看。
options.whyZh: 她沒有質疑訊息是否正確；擔心的是訊息直接告知原因。

options.text: She wants to keep the message out of the activity list so the replay remains unchanged.
options.zh: 她希望訊息不要進入活動紀錄，才能維持原本的重播內容。
options.whyZh: 工程師提議在畫面最上方顯示訊息，講師反對的是何時顯示，而不是它會改動紀錄。

options.text: She wants the learners’ first account of the gap to reflect their own reasoning.
options.zh: 她希望學員第一次解釋那段空白時，能反映自己的推理。
options.whyZh: 上次兩組先把空白歸咎於顯示問題，看到斷線訊息後才改口。這次先收集解釋，才能聽到學員在答案尚未揭曉之前的判斷。

options.text: She plans to let an earlier group explain the gap to a later group.
options.zh: 她打算讓上一組向下一組解釋紀錄中的空白。
options.whyZh: 講師要在檢討練習時才共看訊息，而且工程師還特別要避免下一組先看到上一組的選擇。

explanationZh: 上次兩組先把空白歸咎於顯示問題，看到斷線訊息後才改口。這次先收集解釋，才能聽到學員在答案尚未揭曉之前的判斷。
